### NETWORK ACTIVITY SUMMARY

- Total network flow duration: 1.28 hours

- Primary external communication with malware C&C servers confirmed via packet inspection
- TLSv1.2 encrypted channels established with footprintdns.com subdomains

### CONCLUSION

The affected workstation (10.9.10.102) is infected with Trickbot banking trojan. The malware established multiple C&C communication channels to known Trickbot infrastructure, specifically using domain flux via footprintdns.com. A secondary payload (284.8 KB DLL) was downloaded from the compromised domain simpsonsavingss.com. Immediate containment and remediation actions are required.
